name: RayMajorantIterator
aliases: HDDA-based ray traversal for volume majorant
definition: An iterator that traverses a volume grid using a Hybrid Digital Differential Analyzer (HDDA) to step through voxels/leaves, computing the maximum density (majorant) for each segment where the majorant remains constant. It solves the problem of efficiently determining integration segments for volume path tracing by avoiding per-voxel sampling in empty or uniform regions.
summary: RayMajorantIterator traverses sparse volume grids using HDDA to bundle steps with identical density into segments, efficiently skipping empty regions unlike standard voxel DDA.
